pages.title: Bomb Calorimeter
pages.text: A sample burnt in pure oxygen inside a steel bomb, under a bucket of water: how far the water warms is how much heat it gave.$(br2)$(thing)Tier 1$() machine.
$(thing)Made on the Extreme Assembly Table$() (it is also a crafting table). The recipe pages at the end of this entry - and JEI - show the pattern.

Set the sample's mass and the oxygen pressure. The heat q = m·ΔH_c warms the water by ΔT = q/C (C = 10 kJ/K): size the sample so ΔT sits between 1.5 and 3 K, and give it enough oxygen to burn completely. Each burn makes a Thermochemical Data Card and Insight. The bomb is rated to 35 atm.
$(thing)Machine data$(): a single-block machine (4 item and 2 fluid inputs, 1 and 0 outputs).$(br2)$(thing)Makes$(): Thermochemical Data Card.
